items.name: Anthropic (ANT) IPO LAUNCHED - S-1/A No. 2 sets terms: 825,000,000 Class A shares at USD 70.00-78.00 (update vs 11-09 file)
items.source: SEC EDGAR Form S-1/A Amendment No. 2 (filed 2026-11-10); Anthropic roadshow-launch notice (2026-11-10)
items.size: 825,000,000 Class A shares (801,351,354 primary from the company, 23,648,646 from selling stockholders) at USD 70.00-78.00; 30-day option on 123,750,000 additional primary shares. At the USD 74.00 midpoint: about USD 59.3bn gross primary (derived, 801.35m x 74), USD 61.05bn gross base deal (derived). Concurrent private placement of USD 26.0bn of Class N stock at the IPO price to Google LLC, NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC Partners (illustrative at midpoint: Google and NVIDIA about USD 10bn each, AMD USD 2.5bn, Broadcom/Micron/Microsoft USD 1bn each, TSMC USD 0.5bn). Filing states combined net proceeds of about USD 84.6bn at the midpoint (IPO plus private placement).
items.priced: not priced; roadshow launched 2026-11-10. Expected pricing per IG (secondary, 11-10): Thursday 2026-11-19; TipRanks/Reuters (secondary): pricing the week of 11-16, listing by end-November. No pricing date is stated in the filing.
items.note: Primary (SEC). Nasdaq Global Select, ticker ANT. 22 underwriters led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, then J.P. Morgan, Citigroup, Barclays, Wells Fargo, BofA, Deutsche Bank, RBC, UBS and others. Shares outstanding after offering and private placement: 13,086,672,593 all classes (13,210,422,593 with full option), implying about USD 968bn at the midpoint on basic shares (derived; filing states no valuation; fully diluted with options/RSUs about 18.0bn shares, derived). Lock-ups 180 days (up to 365 days for co-founders and certain 0.5%+ holders) on about 15.5bn shares. Board members/affiliates indicated non-binding interest in up to USD 303m. Anthropic.com notice (11-10) confirms 825m shares, USD 70-78 range, Nasdaq/ANT. Prior night (11-09) a bank-circulated draft showed about 867m shares at USD 70-80 (up to USD 69.3bn) and was retracted by the company as inaccurate (Reuters via Business Standard/TipRanks). Only the first 100k characters of the S-1/A cover/summary plus a second 31k slice were read.
